name: binary_minority_exposure
caption: Minority-class frequencies in 500 fresh unfiltered binary tasks per generator as step histograms; the separate strip marks the minority share min(p,1-p) of each real binary benchmark.

name: accepted_class_exposure
caption: Observed class-count shares among 48 accepted tasks per mixture and cumulative binary minority-share distributions from the same accepted stream, seed 1729; legends give total and binary task counts.

name: candidate_acceptance_difficulty
caption: Accepted/all candidate counts per source and mixture on the left, and cumulative ExtraTrees out-of-bag pseudo-R² for valid candidates versus accepted tables on the right, pooled across the mixtures in the same production-route diagnostic draw; legends give valid-candidate and accepted counts.

name: accepted_feature_exposure
caption: Cumulative distributions of non-padding feature count and the share of features with at most 20 distinct values among 48 accepted tasks per mixture; the latter is a type proxy rather than a categorical schema.

name: correlated_defaults
caption: Realised positive-label rates in 80 controlled tasks at a fixed 15% applicant target rate, with independent and correlated risk; selection, threshold rules, label noise, shifts and scorecard binning are disabled; 400 rows per task and the configured cohort recipe are used, and the second panel varies asset correlation.

name: shift_kinds
caption: Context against query summaries per synthetic task for cohort, covariate, prior-probability and selection shifts, 60 tasks with and 60 without each shift; the dashed line marks equality. Covariate means use the whole-table mean and standard deviation, so their opposite signs follow from centering; their distance from equality records the separation. Open gray squares mark shift-off tasks and blue circles mark shift-on tasks.

name: covariate_missingness
caption: Missing-entry rates in six equally sized groups ordered from the lowest to highest value of one synthetic feature, repeated across six columns in 4,000 rows. Gray squares use a constant missingness probability; blue circles use feature-dependent probabilities. Both target 20% missing entries overall (dotted line); one fixed random draw creates sampling variation. No outcome labels enter the mask.

name: unfiltered_difficulty
caption: ExtraTrees out-of-bag pseudo-R² for 120 unfiltered tasks per generator and real PD benchmarks averaged over three 1,024-row subsamples; marker fill records the hypothetical generic statistical-filter decision.
